QUOTE: "Two options, and the compile-time one wins if both are present (platform.c:16–19)." and "**Compile time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`" and "**Runtime.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` without the macros."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, but it says the compile-time one takes precedence if both are present. That contradicts the item's claim that the two are mutually exclusive.
